name: Liquid Chrome
description: Interactive raymarched metaballs: Oscillator-driven blobs plus one that follows the Mouse, merged with SDFSmoothUnion, in a chrome thin-film (Fresnel-driven CosinePalette) material reflecting a procedural HDR studio with per-channel dispersion, over a dark premium backdrop; ACES grade, bloom render targets, anamorphic streak, chromatic aberration, vignette and grain. Tweak it in the Parameters panel (P): Blobs, Chrome, Backdrop, Post and Music.

data.text:
# Liquid Chrome
Interactive raymarched metaballs: oscillator-driven blobs plus one that follows the mouse, merged with smooth unions into liquid chrome over a mirror floor, with a second raymarch for reflections.
Reacts to music: open the audio menu → Mic (the blobs swell on the kick, the studio lights flare on the beat).
## Tweak it in the Parameters panel
Press P (or the sliders button in the top bar): Blobs, Chrome, Backdrop, Post and Music settings with pretty names; hover a name for what it does, double-click a slider to reset it. Move the mouse over the preview to push the sixth blob around.
Double-click a group box to open it, Esc to come back.

## Scene SDF
Six spheres: five orbit on Oscillators, one follows the mouse. They are chained through smooth unions (k = melt), get a Perlin-noise ripple and sit on a floor plane.

## Chrome Shading
The studio environment is sampled along three slightly bent reflection vectors (RGB dispersion), multiplied by a Fresnel-driven cosine-palette iridescence.

## Reflection Bounce
A second Raymarch starts at the hit point along the reflected ray, so blobs reflect each other; the reflected hit is shaded like the first one.

## Render Targets
Composite → ACES, gamma and saturation into a Feedback render target, plus a two-buffer bright pass for the bloom and lens streak.

## Post FX
Chromatic aberration, two bloom levels, a tinted lens streak, vignette and grain.

## Music
Audio level gates everything: with the audio off or silent, drive = 0 and the piece looks exactly as before. drive = music × smoothstep(level).
- Kick: every blob inflates (the blob distance minus kick × 0.07), a quick liquid swell.
- Bass: the melt radius breathes up to +25%, so the blobs fuse more.
- Beat (attack-decay envelope): the studio strip lights and top light flare in the chrome reflections, and the bloom picks it up.
Beat-phase couplings (studio light flare) are also multiplied by the beat tracker's confidence (Beat.confidence = u_beatConfidence: 0 with the audio off, ~1 once the beat locks, 1 with the metronome) and run on the stable beat clock with its certainty gate (Beat.gate / BeatEnvelope gate: fade, u_beatTrust): after a track change the clock holds the old tempo, then glides to the new one without jumps, and these couplings fade out until the new beat is trusted. Level and band couplings (kick swell, bass melt) are not.

data.description: Smooth-union radius: how much the blobs melt together.

data.description: Perlin-noise ripple on the liquid surface.

data.description: RGB split of the three reflection rays.

data.description: How many thin-film colour bands follow the Fresnel term.

data.description: How much the film colours follow the surface normal.

data.description: Cosine palette phase per channel: shifts the film hues.

data.label: Iridescence
data.description: Strength of the thin-film colours.
